name: flee_script
instruction: Skeletons should run away from the hero when their health drops below 3.
responses:
{
  "scope": "task",
  "summary": "Create a new Lua script for skeletons that makes them flee when health is low, while keeping their existing attack behavior.",
  "plan": [
    "Write a new Lua script that checks health and flees when below 3, otherwise attacks as before.",
    "Replace the skeleton prefab's LuaScript.path with the new script.",
    "Test the new behavior in-game."
  ],
  "operations": [
    {
      "op": "command",
      "name": "script.write",
      "args": {
        "path": "scripts/skeleton_flee.lua",
        "source": "-- skeleton_flee.lua: a melee enemy that flees when health is low.
-- Chasing and fleeing are handled by Follow; this script decides when to
-- swing or run away.

properties = {
    swing_range = 1.1,  -- cells; a bit more than MeleeAttack.reach
    flee_threshold = 3, -- health below this = flee
    taunt = "",        -- a sound to play when it first spots the player
}

local spotted = false
local normal_speed = nil

function update(dt)
    local target, distance = find_nearest("Player")
    if not target then
        return
    end
    if not normal_speed then
        normal_speed = get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed")
    end
    
    -- First sighting: play taunt
    if not spotted and distance < get_field(self_id(), "Follow", "range") then
        spotted = true
        if properties.taunt ~= "" then
            play_sound(properties.taunt)
        end
    end
    
    -- Health check: flee if low
    local hp, max_hp = get_health()
    if hp < properties.flee_threshold then
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", normal_speed * 1.5)
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "target", nil)  -- flee from player
    else
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "speed", normal_speed)
        set_field(self_id(), "Follow", "target", nil)  -- chase player
        if distance < properties.swing_range then
            attack_toward(target)
        end
    end
end
"
      }
    }
  ],
  "done": false,
  "notes": "The new script keeps the skeleton's existing attack behavior (from enemy_melee.lua) and adds fleeing when health is below 3. The next step will attach it to the skeleton prefab."
}
